chapters.title: From Power BI admin to Fabric admin
Workspace architecture from Lego to Jenga

takeaways: Define a domain taxonomy, single ownership and naming rules early, because unchecked domain sprawl hardens fast and spreads further than workspace sprawl.
Separate workspaces by function, enforce naming and lifecycle and automate with templates so experiments never overwrite production data.
Treat Fabric capacity as a shared compute budget and audit tenant defaults, because old Power BI Premium sizing and settings do not carry over safely.
hook: Power BI admins suddenly find themselves running Fabric, with domains, workspaces, capacities and tenant settings that all behave differently. This episode gives Fabric administrators a practical playbook to avoid domain and workspace sprawl, keep governance intact and prevent surprise capacity bills.
